# Dugongs: nonlinear growth curve
# Generated from JuliaBUGS.BUGSExamples.VOLUME_2.dugongs
using JuliaBUGS

model_def = JuliaBUGS.@bugs("""
model {
    for( i in 1 : N ) {
        Y[i] ~ dnorm(mu[i], tau)
        mu[i] <- alpha - beta * pow(gamma,x[i])   
    }
    alpha ~ dunif(0, 100)
    beta ~ dunif(0, 100)
    gamma ~ dunif(0.5, 1.0)
    tau ~ dgamma(0.001, 0.001)
    sigma <- 1 / sqrt(tau)
    U3 <- logit(gamma)   
}
""", false)

build_model(data) = JuliaBUGS.compile(model_def, data)
